caption: The drawing depicts a single, oval-shaped container with two handles on either end, rendered in shades of brown. The exterior surface of the container is primarily a reddish-brown color, with visible lines suggesting seams or divisions, and faint white markings resembling scratches or wear. A decorative green foliate pattern runs horizontally along the upper side, encircling the container just beneath its rim and extending onto the handles, which are integrated into the body of the vessel. The inside base of the container features a circular design with stylized floral motifs in red, green, and gray, contrasting with the otherwise plain interior. The drawing is set against a plain, pale beige background with no additional objects present.
title: Bread Tray
